data.frames: 404 block-T frames (135 with n = 2, 157 with n = 3, 112 with n = 4; none with n = 5) and the 24-frame dev slice of 2021_08_22_13_37_16 (data/opv2v/devslice, block T)

verbatim.scope: E3 — candidate-tile counterfactual (development block T only; no downloads; no calibration/test data touched).
verbatim.idea: Idea: post-fusion computation and the per-pixel attention fusion are pixel-local (V-03), so the counterfactual Y-(i) evaluated on a chosen subset of tiles is exact on those tiles. Unlike the E1 "footprint" variant, tiles are chosen by where detections can occur, and outputs outside the subset are NOT copied from Y+; candidates there are simply treated as absent from Y-(i).
steps: 1. Verify tile exactness: for the tile-gathered decode (reuse _to_tiles/decode_batch), check that head outputs on the selected tiles equal the dense counterfactual on 24/24 frames (max abs diff ≤ 1e-5). If not exact, stop and report why.

2. Trigger T(f): tiles containing any Y+ candidate with score ≥ f (anchor-level, pre-NMS), dilated by 1 tile. Pre-register f ∈ {0.05, 0.10} (detection threshold is OpenCOOD's score_threshold); report both, choose nothing post hoc.

3. On all 404 cached block-T frames, all conditions: effect recall vs dense counterfactual (fraction of dense ADD/REMOVE/SHIFT effects reproduced exactly), reported by type; R1 gating-choice agreement; AP@0.7 and recovery with R1 vs dense R1.

4. On the 24-frame slice, overhead at n = 2 (D-42 protocol) for each f, p50/p95, plus mean fraction of tiles selected. For n = 3..5 report the tile fraction from real block-T multi-agent frames and the projected cost (measured per-tile cost × tiles).
outcomes: PASS if for some f: n = 2 overhead ≤ 10% p95 (≤ 15% p95 with the isolated-encode denominator), effect recall ≥ 0.98 for every type, and R1 AP@0.7 recovery within 0.02 of dense on every family. Then recommend streaming the 4 small scenarios as a held-out check of frozen R1 + this trigger.
PARTIAL if recall/AP criteria pass but overhead is 10–25% p95: stop and report; the budget decision is mine.
FAIL otherwise: stop; record that the counterfactual cost cannot be reduced exactly on this CPU.

deviation_approved_before_running.what: Re-stream the same 3 block-T scenarios (same allowlist, source URL and safety checks as runners/e0_stream.py; E0 downloaded 4.26 GB). This overrides the request's 'no downloads'.
deviation_approved_before_running.why: OpenCOOD's score_threshold is 0.20 (checkpoint config.yaml) and the E0 caches store only candidates above it (compose.candidates applies the threshold). T(0.05) and T(0.10) need Y+ anchor scores in [f, 0.20), which are not cached, and the raw block-T data was deleted after E0 (only the 24-frame slice is on disk).
deviation_approved_before_running.approved: by the user in chat on 2026-10-23 (option 'Re-stream block T'), before this file was written
deviation_approved_before_running.safeguards: allowlist = the 3 block-T scenarios only; one scenario on disk at a time; raw data <= 3e9 bytes; new download ledger runs/20261023-E3/download_ledger.json with a 4.6e9-byte budget; raw data deleted after the E3 cache has been written and re-read

implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.reproduction_check: During the re-stream, every (frame, condition) is recomputed with the E0 code and seeds (e0_stream.frame_seed / rng_for, attack_features, attack_points). The recomputed dense Y+ candidates must equal the cached cands[frozenset()] (identical anchor indices; corners and scores bitwise equal). Any mismatch: stop and report; nothing in step 3 is computed from mismatching frames.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.tile_grid: 6.4 m tiles = 8 x 8 head cells; head grid 100 x 352 -> 13 x 44 = 572 tiles (the last tile row is half outside the grid and zero-padded; padded cells are dropped). Tile fraction = |T| / 572.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.trigger: T(f) = tiles (r, c) such that some Y+ anchor (any of the 2 anchors) in the tile has sigmoid(cls logit) >= f, computed from the plain-path head output psm (anchor-level, pre-NMS, no box filters); dilated by 1 tile with a 3 x 3 (Chebyshev) neighbourhood, clipped to the grid. T(f) is the same for every sender of a frame. f in {0.05, 0.10}; both reported; neither chosen post hoc.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.trigger_mode: per sender i: gather the per-scale agent features of the tiles in T(f) (tile = 8/4/2 cells at scales 0/1/2), fuse them with fuse_scale with sender i excluded (same include-mask path as the dense counterfactual), decode all senders' tiles in one decode_batch, map tile outputs back to full-grid anchor indices, and run compose.candidates' operations (sigmoid, delta_to_boxes3d, score_threshold 0.20, corners, projection) on those anchors only. Candidates outside T(f) are absent from Y-(i) (not copied from Y+). Y-(i)_T = finalize(those candidates); effects(Y+, Y-(i)_T) with the unchanged effects.py; then rays, R1 and compose exactly as in mint_frame.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step1_exactness: On the 24 dev-slice frames (n = 2): psm and rm of the trigger-mode decode on every tile of T(0.05) and of T(0.10), and separately on all 572 tiles, vs the dense counterfactual decode(fuse(sender 1 excluded)) at the same cells (padded cells excluded). Criterion: max abs diff <= 1e-5 on 24/24 frames for T(0.05) and T(0.10). Also reported: whether the resulting candidate anchor indices equal the dense candidates restricted to T(f). If the criterion fails: stop and report why.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step3_counterfactual_used: Primary: Y-(i)_T candidates = the cached dense Y-(i) candidates restricted to anchors whose tile is in T(f) (Candidates.take), which equals the trigger-mode decode wherever step 1 holds. Secondary check on all 404 frames during the re-stream: the real trigger-mode decode's candidate anchor indices vs that restriction (count of frames with any difference; max abs score / corner diff).
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step3_population: as E1/E2: every frame of the 3 scenarios under clean + 4 families; a family on a frame where the attack was not applied, or a frame with n = 1, is evaluated as clean (e0_analyze.cond_of). Pooled over these (frame, condition) evaluations; also reported per condition.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.effect_recall: dense effects = effects(Y+, finalize(dense Y-(i))) per sender (= the cached E0 effects). A dense effect is reproduced iff effects(Y+, Y-(i)_T) of the same sender contains an effect of the same type with bitwise-identical plus and minus boxes (None = None). Recall per type = reproduced / dense, pooled over all senders and (frame, condition) evaluations. Criterion uses this pooled value for each of ADD, REMOVE, SHIFT. Also reported: per condition x type, and trigger effects that have no identical dense effect ('spurious') by type.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.rays_for_new_effects: rays (std and gnd records as E0 ray_rec) for trigger effects whose boxes do not occur in the dense effects are computed during the re-stream from the receiver's float64 points (as E0) and stored; reproduced effects reuse the cached E0 ray records (identical box -> identical rays).
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.r1_agreement: R1 (v0.Params(), as E1) on the dense and trigger effects of each (frame, condition): fraction of evaluations whose gating choice {tile: excluded set} is identical; unit counts gated by both / dense only / trigger only.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.composition_trigger: gated output = finalize(compose(cands_T, choice_T)) with cands_T = {empty: dense Y+, {i}: Y-(i)_T}; a tile gating >= 2 senders uses the cached dense candidates of that subset, which equals a tile-restricted extra decode of the gated tiles (compose only reads candidates in the gated tiles). Gated tiles outside T(f) are counted and reported; they get no Y-(i) candidates.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.ap_and_recovery: as E1: OpenCOOD AP@0.7 pooled over frames; recovery = (AP_R1 - AP_undef) / (AP_clean_undef - AP_undef) per family, for R1-dense and R1-trigger; criterion |recovery_trigger - recovery_dense| <= 0.02 for each of the 4 families. Clean relative loss reported for both (not a criterion). R1-dense must reproduce the E1/E2 values.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step4_overhead: 24-frame slice, n = 2, Apple M1 CPU, torch threads 8 intra-op / 1 inter-op; one untimed warm-up on frame 0. Per frame: first the isolated receiver encode (receiver_features alone, 5 reps, per-frame median); then 3 interleaved repetitions, each in the order baseline-only (receiver encode + plain_only), dense sequential MINT (reference), trigger MINT f = 0.05, trigger MINT f = 0.10, each MINT run preceded by its own receiver encode (D-42). MINT extra = everything after the plain path (trigger mask + tile gather + fusion + decode + candidates + finalize + effects + evidence + compose). Overhead = extra / baseline-only of the same repetition; isolated-encode overhead = extra / (isolated encode p50 over the 24 frames + plain_only of the same repetition). Per-frame median over repetitions, then p50/p95 over the 24 frames. The outcome uses the p95 values; for some f both overhead <= 0.10 and isolated-encode overhead <= 0.15 are required for PASS. Bands for PARTIAL: overhead p95 in (0.10, 0.25]; the isolated-encode value is reported next to it.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step4_tile_fraction: mean and p50/p95 of |T(f)| / 572 over the 24 slice frames (clean) and, from the re-stream, over the 404 block-T frames per condition and per n.
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.step4_projection: per-tile cost c_tile(f) = per-frame median of (tile gather + fusion + decode time of the trigger stage) / |T(f)| at n = 2, p50 over the 24 frames; c_sender(f) = per-sender candidates + finalize + effects p50; c_fixed(f) = trigger mask + evidence + compose p50. For each real block-T frame with n agents (n = 3: 157 frames, n = 4: 112, clean condition): projected extra = (n - 1) * (|T(f)| * c_tile + c_sender) + c_fixed; projected overhead = projected extra / baseline-only p50 at n agents, measured on the slice with n - 1 replicated sender features (timing only, as E1/E2; 3 reps). n = 5 has no real block-T frames: projected with the tile fractions of all 269 multi-agent frames (T depends only on Y+), labelled as such. Projections are not measurements; evidence and compose costs are held at their n = 2 values (caveat stated).
implementation_clarifications_fixed_befo.no_changes: R1, effects parameters, harm labels, the AP evaluation and decision_log.md are not changed; proposals go to planning/decision_log_proposed_appendix.md only

correction_2026-10-23.written: 2026-10-23, after the E3 step-1 result (commit 9e1e173) and before any E3 step 2-4 result exists; the user's decision, given in chat
correction_2026-10-23.status: post-hoc correction of the step-1 criterion only
correction_2026-10-23.reason: The original absolute bound (max abs diff <= 1e-5 on psm/rm) was mis-specified: it is ~10 float32 ULP at logit magnitudes of 10-15, and the dense-equivalent all-572-tile path itself fails it on 17/24 frames. The deviation is accumulation-order rounding in deblocks/heads (fusion is bitwise equal).
correction_2026-10-23.revised_step1_criterion: On 24/24 frames, for T(0.05) and T(0.10): (a) candidate anchor indices above score_threshold identical to the dense candidates restricted to T(f); (b) candidate score diff <= 1e-5 and corner diff <= 1e-4 m; (c) all psm/rm diffs <= 32 float32 ULP of the dense value. This uses no cost, recall or AP information.
correction_2026-10-23.ulp_definition: ULP of the dense value v = numpy.spacing(abs(float32(v))); evaluated per element over every non-padded cell of every selected tile, both heads (psm, rm).
correction_2026-10-23.unchanged: Everything else in this pre-registration (steps 2-4, f in {0.05, 0.10}, PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL bands, the approved block-T re-stream and its safeguards, implementation clarifications) is unchanged.
correction_2026-10-23.evaluation: Re-evaluate step 1 from the existing step-1 outputs if they contain what is required; otherwise re-run step 1 only. If the revised criterion fails: stop.

correction_2_2026-10-23.written: 2026-10-23, after the D-46 step-1 result (commit 49b7214) and before any E3 step 2-4 result exists; the user's decision, given in chat
correction_2_2026-10-23.status: second and final post-hoc correction of the step-1 criterion only
correction_2_2026-10-23.reason: Criterion (c) of correction_2026-10-23 (all psm/rm diffs <= 32 float32 ULP of the dense value) was mis-specified: the ULP is relative to each value, so near-zero rm/psm elements fail with absolute diffs <= 3.9e-6, and the dense-equivalent all-572-tile path fails it worse (max 34.6M ULP) than the T(f) tile paths (max 1.4M ULP). Element-wise bounds below rounding noise cannot distinguish the tile method from a path that is exact by construction.
correction_2_2026-10-23.final_step1_criterion: (a) and (b) of correction_2026-10-23 on 24/24 frames, for T(0.05) and T(0.10): (a) candidate anchor indices above score_threshold identical to the dense candidates restricted to T(f); (b) candidate score diff <= 1e-5 and corner diff <= 1e-4 m. Criterion (c) is dropped.
correction_2_2026-10-23.finality: This is the last change to step 1; no further revision of step 1 will be made regardless of later results.
correction_2_2026-10-23.information_used: No cost, recall or AP information is used.
correction_2_2026-10-23.evaluation: Evaluated from the existing runs/20261023-E3/step1_revised.json ((a) and (b) recorded per frame for both f); step 1 is not re-run.
correction_2_2026-10-23.unchanged: Steps 2-4, f in {0.05, 0.10}, the PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL bands (effect recall >= 0.98 per type, AP@0.7 recovery within 0.02 of dense on every family, n = 2 overhead bands), the approved block-T re-stream and its safeguards, and all implementation clarifications are unchanged. Steps 2-4 test end-to-end equivalence.
